description: This Java class 'WorkEffortKeywordIndex' is responsible for indexing keywords related to work effort entities within the OFBiz framework. It extracts various properties and content associated with a work effort, processes keywords with weighting, and stores them for search purposes.

classes.name: WorkEffortKeywordIndex
classes.description: A utility class for indexing keywords associated with work effort entities, facilitating search and retrieval functionalities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Indexes keywords for a given work effort GenericValue, extracting relevant properties and content, applying weighting, and storing the keywords for search purposes.

methods.name: addWeightedDataResourceString
methods.description: Fetches content from a data resource and adds it to the list of strings multiple times based on the specified weight.

methods.name: addWeightedKeywordSourceString
methods.description: Adds a string value from a specified field of a GenericValue to the list multiple times based on configured weighting, for indexing.
